artworks.title: The Lamentation of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 32.1 × 23.3 cm (12 5/8 × 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with two figures. One figure is lying on a slab, while the other figure is standing and looking down at them. The standing figure is draped in robes and has a halo-like aura around their head. The background shows hills, trees, and a town. The drawing is detailed, with line work and shading emphasizing the figures and surroundings. Soft tones are used, giving the piece a timeless quality.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a man's head and neck, capturing his face fully frontal while slightly turned. The man is in a relaxed position, with a long, flowing beard and neatly combed hair, parted on the side. His facial features include pronounced cheekbones, straight eyebrows, and a slightly furrowed brow. His mouth is softly closed, and his eyes appear to be gazing off into the distance. The man’s attire is not fully visible, but the suggestion of a collar can be seen. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held, as the focus is primarily on his upper body and facial features. The background of the sketch is plain, highlighting the detailed pencil work on the individual's face and hair. The signature "Renoi" appears at the bottom right of the drawing.

artworks.title: Louis Valtat
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated on a chair in a three-quarter view facing right. He has a full beard and short hair, mostly covered by a flat cap. He has a prominent mustache and a strong jawline, with a thoughtful expression. He wears a jacket over a shirt with the jacket open and the shirt collar visible. He is holding a piece of paper or a book in one hand resting on his lap, while the other hand rests on the back of the chair. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ambroise Vollard
artworks.description: The image is a drawing showing the profile of a man's head and shoulders. He is facing left with his head slightly tilted downward. The man has a full beard and closely cropped dark hair. His facial features are depicted in profile with soft shading. He is wearing a suit with a high collar. There is no jewelry or objects in the image. The background is textured and minimalist. A signature, possibly "Renoir," is located near the bottom right of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Standard Bearer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with long, wavy hair, wearing a hat with a feather. They have distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and lips, and are wearing a ruffled shirt under a vest-like garment. The individual is holding a staff in their right hand and possibly a sword in their left hand. The background is dark, emphasizing the focus on the subject.

artworks.title: Sleeping Woman
artworks.medium: chalk and charcoal on cream wove paper mounted on paperboard
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (irregular bottom edge): 25 × 17.6 cm (9 13/16 × 6 15/16 in.)
mount: 35.9 × 27.8 cm (14 1/8 × 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a seated person in a relaxed pose. Their facial features are softly sketched, with eyes closed or looking downward. The person's hair is medium-length and their hands are possibly resting in their lap. They are wearing dark outerwear over a lighter inner garment, with no visible jewelry. The background consists of dense, dark, crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: United States Military Academy, Song of the Graduates
artworks.artist: Napoleon Sarony, after James McNeill Whistler
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on folded wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals facing each other from the knees up. The person on the left wears a military-style uniform with a buttoned coat, epaulettes, and a hat while the person on the right holds a rifle. Both individuals have neat hair under their hats and detailed facial features. The background includes hills, trees, and water. The scene is framed with a decorative border and text related to the "United States Military Academy Song of the Graduates 1852" cover.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.4 x 19 cm (10 x 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine but densely spaced black lines, a man hunches over a table writing in the far corner of a room in this vertical engraving. A lion and a dog lie on the floor closer to us, both with their eyes closed. Arched window openings along the left wall are filled with bullseye glass, and that wall is lined with a bench. A chest and a pair of slippers are tucked under the bench, closer to us. On the bench are three books and two pillows. In the window well closer to us is another book and a skull. The man sits at a square table with trestle legs in the far corner next to the second bay of windows. A small crucifix is at the front left corner of the table. The man, who is balding with long hair, wears a cassock and heavy robes. His feet and knees are pressed together, and his hands are close to each other on the angled writing surface. A glow around his head creates a halo. The only other object on the table is his ink pot. On the far wall are an hourglass, a flat topped, wide-brimmed hat, a rosary, and hand broom. Pieces of paper and a pair of scissors tucked into bands pinned to the wall, and a shelf above holds candles and vessels. The ceiling is made of wood beams, and a pear-shaped gourd hangs at the top right corner. A wide chair holding a cushion sits near the table, and the artist’s initials, AD, and the date, 1514, are on a tablet that lies on the floor nearby.

artworks.title: The Little Courier
artworks.description: Printed with both fine and densely layered black lines on cream-white paper, a man and the horse he rides are angled away from us, to our left, in this vertical engraving. The horse’s front hooves are raised off the ground as it pushes off its back legs in mid-stride or leap. The horse’s chin is pulled back by the reins the man holds in his left hand, by his lap. The rider’s profile has a long nose, and his mouth is open over the suggestion of a beard. The rest of his face and head is covered by a fur cap. A long feather flows from the brim, over his right shoulder. That arm is raised as he holds up a whip. The shoulders of his long-sleeved, tight-fitting jacket are slashed, and there are four slashes creating a loose X shape on his mid-back. The leggings or pants on the leg we can see are vertically striped under a thigh-high boot, which folds over at the top. His pointed shoe hooks through the stirrup of the horse’s saddle, and a spur juts out from the heel. A sword hangs by the man’s left side, closer to us. The pair travel on a clear path lined on both sides with grasses, rocks, and trees. Closest to us, in the lower left corner, a smooth-topped, cut tree stump is surrounded by grasses and a few stalks. On the far side of the horse, a narrow grove of darkly shaded trees rises along the right edge of the composition, and the tallest tree extends off the top. In the distance to our left, steep, vertical cliffs and hills are engraved in lightly incised lines, so look more faint. Trees and structures are suggested with a few strokes. The topmost structures come about five-sixths of the way up the composition, and the sky above is blank white. The artist signed the lower center of the engraving with his monogram, an uppercase D tucked between the long legs of a wide uppercase A.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Lion and a Cock
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic crest featuring a rooster and a lion. The drawing presents a detailed depiction of a crest with a rooster at the top, standing on a helmet, and a lion rampant on a shield below. Surrounding the main elements are elaborate flourishes and scrollwork. The drawing displays meticulous lines and shading, creating depth and texture typical of detailed heraldic designs.

artworks.title: Saint George on Horseback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted armored figure on a horse standing over a defeated opponent. The image presents a valiant figure in full armor atop a horse, suggesting a scene of victory or conquest. The mount is detailed, with an ornate bridle. The equestrian figure wields a lance in a position of triumph, while beneath lies a defeated adversary. The shading technique emphasizes texture and depth in both the armor and the horse’s features. The style and dated inscription suggest influences from Renaissance artistry.

artworks.title: Saint Eustace
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling beside a horse, with several dogs nearby and a stag standing among trees to the right. A grand castle on a rocky hill dominates the horizon. The detailed etching techniques depict various textures and the monochrome palette emphasizes the intricate details. In the distance, dense foliage and the castle create a balanced backdrop.

artworks.title: Melencolia I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.5 x 19.2 cm (9 5/8 x 7 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: Created with fine black lines printed on an ivory-white paper, a winged woman sits with her head in one hand, surrounded by tools, a dog, and a baby-like, winged putto perched on a millstone, all in front of a distant landscape with a still body of water under an arched rainbow in this vertical engraving. Filling the lower right quadrant of the composition, the winged woman, Melencolia, sits with her body angled to our left, and she looks in that direction from under furrowed brows. Lit from our right, her face is cast in shadow, but she has a straight nose and her lips are closed. She wears a ring of leaves over hair that falls in waves over her shoulders. Wings curve up from her back, and she wears a long-sleeved dress with a tight bodice and a voluminous, pleated skirt. She rests her chin on one tightly closed fist. The other arm rests on a book in her lap, and she holds one of the two legs of a tall compass in that hand. Several keys hang on a ribbon looped onto her belt, and they nestle into the deep folds of her skirt. Around her feet are a purse cinched closed, several nails, the metal tip of a bellows, a saw, a plane, the end of a pair of pincers, an ink pot, a molder’s form for baseboards, and a round sphere about the size of a basketball. The dog lies in a tight circle to our left of Melencolia’s feet, its chin resting across its paws. The dog’s ribs show through the short fur of its hide. Next to the dog, the millstone leans against the building that fills the right half of the composition. The millstone is round and flat, is about the height of the woman's torso, and a hole is cut from its center. A chubby child sits atop the stone. It has short, curly hair, stubby wings, a loose robe, and it draws on a tablet propped on its lap. Beyond the child, a wooden ladder leans against the building, and a pair of scales hangs above his head. On the face of the building, hanging over Melencolia’s head, is an hourglass with the sand about halfway spent and a magic square, which is a grid of four rows and four columns. The numbers in the grid read, from left to right, 16, 3, 2, 13 in the top row; an upside down 5, a 10, 11, and 8 in the second row; a backward 9, a 6, 7, and 12 in the third row; and a 4, 15, 14, and 1 in the bottom row. A bell hangs from a ring above this grid. On the step beyond the sleeping dog and millstone, another large stone is carved into flat planes to create an irregular, geometric, rhomboid form about as tall as the millstone. A hammer lies in front of the rhomboid, and beyond it is a melting pot sitting among tongues of flame in a mug-like cup. In the upper left quadrant of the composition, a placid body of water leads back to a distant town and small boats, beneath a starburst that fills the sky. An arched rainbow crosses the sky over a rat-like bat with its sharp teeth and tongue showing. It holds a banner reading “MELENCOLIA I.” The artist signed and dated the engraving as if he had carved into the front face of the step on which Melencolia sits, near the lower right corner: “1514 AD,” with the uppercase D nestled between the long legs of the wide, uppercase A.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.9 x 19.3 cm (9 13/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This black-and-white print shows two nude adults, a man and a woman, in full body view standing side by side. The man is positioned on the left, holding up a branch with a parrot perched on it. A small sign hangs from the branch, featuring the artist's name ("ALBERT DVRER") and a date ("1504"). The man turns to look at the woman on the right, with his other hand stretched towards her and one of his legs slightly bent. His facial features are defined, with a straight nose, a slightly furrowed brow, and curly hair framing his face. The woman on the right has long wavy hair cascading down her back. Her face is turned to the left, towards the man, as she reaches out with one hand. In her hand she holds a piece of round fruit, and a snake coils around a branch from the tree behind her, descending towards her and appearing to take a bite of the fruit. She holds another piece of fruit in her other hand, partially hidden. Both individuals have light skin and are bare except for leaves covering their groins. The background is dense with trees and foliage, including more fruit hanging from the central tree, and there are various animals on the ground behind the couple, such as a cat, an elk, a bull, a mouse, and a rabbit. In the top right corner, a jagged rock mountain top is visible with a goat standing on it.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with a dilapidated building and a well. The image shows a complex architectural structure with a blend of ruin and domestic activity. On the left is a half-timbered building with a thatched roof, open windows, and exposed beams. Next to it is a stone archway leading to greenery and distant small dwellings. In the foreground, there is an old well with a pulley system and several figures engaged in daily tasks. Various objects like jugs and wooden items clutter the scene, indicating rural life. The background features lush trees and a cliff overlooking part of the structure.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with the Monkey
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.1 x 12.3 cm (7 1/2 x 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines and velvety black shading on off-white paper, a woman, baby, and monkey sit in a landscape with a body of water and a house on the far bank in this vertical engraving. In the center of the composition, the woman sits with her knees angled slightly to our right, but she turns to look down at the baby, held at her other hip. She has hooded eyes, a straight, thin nose, thin lips, and a rounded, narrow chin. Long wavy hair falls behind her shoulders, and her dress has a square neckline and voluminous sleeves and skirt. The sleeve of her left arm, to our right, is pushed up to the elbow, and that hand rests on the spin of a book. The nude child leans into her other hand, looking at a bird he holds by the legs. The child has short, curly hair, round cheeks, and a pudgy body. With his other hand, he holds up a small sack pierced with holes to the bird, which flaps its wings wide. The monkey crouches at the woman’s right foot, to our left, and comes almost to her knee. The animal’s eyes slant dramatically up at the outer corners, and a blaze of fur surrounds its face. It is tied around the middle and tethered to an iron ring affixed to a low, wooden, garden wall. The woman and child sit in the corner of the wall, which continues toward us to the right. Sailboats dot the water, which leads back to a tiny, distant town and mountains on the horizon. In the top third of the print, puffy and screens of clouds span the sky. The artist signed the print with his initials, an uppercase “D” tucked between the long legs of an uppercase “A” in the lower center.

artworks.title: Nemesis (The Great Fortune)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.4 x 23 cm (13 1/8 x 9 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing on a sphere above a landscape. The figure appears to be a nude, female-like form with large wings and a flowing ribbon-like cloth draped around her body. She holds a cup or chalice in one hand and stands atop a smooth orb, balancing above a detailed scene below. The landscape beneath her is meticulously detailed, depicting a medieval town with a river winding through it, nestled among rolling hills and rocky cliffs. Each building and tree is rendered with intricate lines, showcasing an expansive view that gives a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Harbor Scene with Rising Sun (Le soleil levant)
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene featuring ancient ruins and maritime activities. Large architectural ruins with columns are on the left, with figures performing tasks nearby. A horse is harnessed to a cart, and small boats are being managed by sailors to the right. Larger ships are anchored in the distance near a fortified coastline with towers. The horizon is indicated by the waterline just above the ships. The sketch-like composition includes detailed cross-hatching and fine lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown, creating an antiquated feel.

artworks.title: The Herd Returning in Stormy Weather (Le troupeau en marche par un temps orageux)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with a slightly elevated view. On the left are detailed columns resembling remnants of a structure. On the right, a figure tends to cattle and goats. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, showing hills, mountains, trees, and a distant fortification. The sky has clouds, depicted with fine line work typical of etchings. The color scheme is monochromatic with earthy browns and sepias.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and blue wash and graphite, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low, with hills fading into the distance, enhancing the sense of depth. Trees with delicate branches frame the scene. The brushstrokes are fine and controlled, contributing to a dreamy quality. The color scheme is primarily soft blues and grays. A group of figures is seated on a knoll in the foreground, blending into the serene surroundings. The overall scene captures a tranquil moment with a harmonious use of color and form.

artworks.title: Tourelle de la Rue de la Tixéranderie, Paris (House with a Turret, Weavers' Street, Paris)
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural street scene captured from a straight-on perspective. The focus is on the intricate design of the buildings, with a prominent conical tower in the center. Various rooftops with smokestacks emitting smoke are visible. The artwork is detailed in an etching style with a monochromatic sepia color palette. Small human figures are shown near us, some standing and others moving along a cobbled street, adding scale and activity to the scene.

artworks.title: La Pompe Notre-Dame, Paris (The Notre-Dame Pump)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex structure on wooden stilts over a river. On the left, there is a tower rising above the building complex with slanted roofs. The scene is filled with buildings extending into the distance, with no clear horizon visible. The etching features fine, detailed brushstrokes emphasizing intricate linework capturing textures of stone, wood, and water. The image has a monochromatic palette of sepia tones. Other buildings are densely packed beyond the structures on stilts, including one resembling a cathedral or significant architectural landmark. The water reflects the structures, and a few small boats with figures are visible.

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape view from a high vantage point. A stone gargoyle is perched on the edge of a building, appearing as if it is looking over the city with its chin resting on its hand. The city features detailed buildings and rooftops, with a tall Gothic-style tower in the distance. Birds are flying around, adding movement to the scene. The artwork has intricate linework and a monochrome color palette, emphasizing contrast between light and shadow to enhance the three-dimensional effect of the structures and the gargoyle.

artworks.title: Saint-Etienne-du-Mont, Paris (Church of St. Stephen of the Mount, Paris)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an urban architectural scene viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing a street leading to a church. The large church building features a rose window at its center and a tall bell tower. Buildings flank the view, with one showing aged brickwork and arched windows, and the other having scaffolding and workmen. The precise lines capture intricate details, creating depth and texture. The monochromatic color palette uses sepia tones, enhancing the historical feel. In the distance, figures and activities are subtly depicted.
